# Munch

> Munch is a privacy-conscious, ChatGPT-first nutrition service. ChatGPT provides the conversation and reasoning; Munch provides persistent nutrition records, verified food search, saved foods, goals, water and weight history, trends, exports, deletion, billing entitlements, and OAuth-protected MCP tools.

Munch is designed for use through ChatGPT and compatible MCP clients rather than as a standalone nutrition application. Users can describe meals naturally, search USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts, look up barcodes, save usual foods, review daily progress and longer-term trends, and manage their account through conversation.

Munch does not train a Munch model on nutrition records, sell nutrition data, or use Google Analytics or advertising trackers. OpenAI separately controls ChatGPT conversation processing, retention, and training choices according to the user's ChatGPT plan, settings, and OpenAI policies.

## Access and billing

- Munch has a permanent Free tier for core nutrition logging, daily progress, water and weight tracking, imports, exports, connections, and account deletion.
- Optional Premium capabilities are managed on the Munch website. ChatGPT connection and MCP use do not require a subscription prompt or payment.
- Premium is $4.99/month for the owner. Additional household members are $2/month each after they accept an invitation; invitations are free until accepted.
- Checkout, recurring billing, payment methods, invoices, and cancellation are handled through Stripe on the website.

## Nutrition sources

Munch prioritizes structured sources and confirmed history:

1. USDA FoodData Central
2. Open Food Facts and barcode records
3. User-confirmed saved foods and prior meals
4. AI-assisted estimates when stronger structured data is unavailable

Sources and assumptions should remain visible. Munch is a consumer wellness product and does not provide medical advice.

## Open-source attribution

Munch began as a fork of the MIT-licensed Nutrition MCP project by Alexander Kutishevsky. Munch preserves the original license and attribution while operating as an independent hosted product.
